mobile_grid_pref.value: Compact stacked cards (more products per screen)

mobile_info_density.value: Moderate (Balanced - some details visible, click for more)

mobile_navigation.value: Bottom Nav (Navigation bar at the bottom - mobile style)

mobile_search_visibility.value: Collapsible (Search bar that expands when clicked)

mobile_product_card.value: Info Rich (Lots of details, ratings, specs visible)

mobile_price_display.value: Strike-through Original (Shows original price crossed out with sale price)

mobile_filter_location.value: Drawer Overlay (Slides in from the side when clicked)

mobile_quick_view.value: Slide-Up Panel (Preview product details in a slide-up panel without leaving the product lis)

mobile_review_display.value: Collapsible Sections (Reviews can be expanded or collapsed within the product details)

mobile_sticky_header.value: Yes (Header stays at top while scrolling)
